The '''attack on Belsavis''' was a small assault on the [[Plawal Rift]] region of the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. The Plawal Rift was the location of a small enclave of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Children of the Jedi|refugees]], mainly children, looked after by the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plett]] in the wake of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. After [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] learned of the enclave, he commissioned the battlemoon ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' to destroy it. However, the battlemoon was disabled in the [[Moonflower Nebula/Legends|Moonflower Nebula]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Callista Ming|Callista Masana]] and [[Geith Eris]]. A wing of Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] subsequently assaulted the enclave, but the refugees managed to escape as they were forewarned of the coming danger.
